common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and use Copy.

GIT_NOT_FOUND.title: Git was not found
GIT_NOT_FOUND.hint: Install Git on the host running Paseo and make sure it is on the daemon's PATH, then restart the daemon.

NOT_A_REPOSITORY.title: Not a Git repository
NOT_A_REPOSITORY.hint: The folder is not the top level of a Git work tree. It may have been moved or deleted; refresh the repository list.

INVALID_ARGUMENT.title: Invalid input
INVALID_ARGUMENT.hint: Check the name, path or value you entered and try again.

PATH_OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY.title: Path outside the repository
PATH_OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY.hint: Only files inside the repository can be used here.

REPOSITORY_BUSY.title: The repository is busy
REPOSITORY_BUSY.hint: Another operation on this repository took too long to finish. Wait for it, then try again.

INDEX_LOCKED.title: The index is locked
INDEX_LOCKED.hint: Another Git process may be running. If none is, remove the .git/index.lock file by hand; Advanced Git never deletes it.

TIMEOUT.title: Git took too long
TIMEOUT.hint: Git was stopped after its time limit. Check the network or the repository's size, then try again.

OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE.title: Too much output
OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE.hint: Git produced more output than Advanced Git reads. Narrow the request, for example with a filter.

AUTH_FAILED.title: Authentication failed
AUTH_FAILED.hint: Configure a credential helper or ssh-agent for Git on the host running Paseo. Advanced Git never asks for passwords or tokens.

HOST_KEY_VERIFICATION_FAILED.title: Host key verification failed
HOST_KEY_VERIFICATION_FAILED.hint: The remote's SSH host key is unknown or has changed. Verify it and add it to known_hosts on the host running Paseo.

NETWORK.title: The remote could not be reached
NETWORK.hint: Check the host's network connection and the remote's URL, then try again.

REMOTE_REJECTED.title: The remote rejected the push
REMOTE_REJECTED.hint: A hook or a protection rule on the remote refused it. Read Git's message below for the reason.

NON_FAST_FORWARD.title: The branch has diverged
NON_FAST_FORWARD.hint: The remote has commits you do not have. Pull (or sync) first, then push again.

NO_UPSTREAM.title: No upstream branch
NO_UPSTREAM.hint: This branch does not follow a remote branch. Publish it, or set its upstream.

NO_REMOTE.title: No remote
NO_REMOTE.hint: The repository has no remote of that name. Add a remote first.

MERGE_CONFLICT.title: Conflicts
MERGE_CONFLICT.hint: The operation stopped on conflicts. Resolve them in the Changes view, then continue or abort.

WOULD_OVERWRITE_CHANGES.title: Local changes are in the way
WOULD_OVERWRITE_CHANGES.hint: Commit or stash your changes first, or choose to stash them automatically.

UNMERGED_BRANCH.title: The branch is not merged
UNMERGED_BRANCH.hint: Deleting it would lose commits. Merge it first, or force the delete if the safety settings allow it.

REF_EXISTS.title: The name is already used
REF_EXISTS.hint: A branch, tag, remote or worktree of that name exists. Choose another name.

REF_NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
REF_NOT_FOUND.hint: The branch, tag, remote, stash or revision is no longer there. Refresh and try again.

NOTHING_TO_COMMIT.title: Nothing to commit
NOTHING_TO_COMMIT.hint: Stage some changes first, or commit all changes.

IDENTITY_MISSING.title: Your Git identity is not set
IDENTITY_MISSING.hint: Set user.name and user.email in Git's configuration on the host running Paseo.

OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS.title: An operation is in progress
OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS.hint: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert or bisect is under way. Continue or abort it first.

NO_OPERATION.title: No operation in progress
NO_OPERATION.hint: There is nothing to continue, skip or abort. Refresh the repository.

FORBIDDEN_BY_POLICY.title: Not allowed by the safety settings
FORBIDDEN_BY_POLICY.hint: Turn on “{{setting}}” in Advanced Git's safety settings for this host to allow it.

PROTECTED_BRANCH.title: Protected branch
PROTECTED_BRANCH.hint: The branch matches a protected-branch pattern in the safety settings, so this operation is refused.

CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.title: Confirmation required
CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.hint: This operation can lose work and must be confirmed. Try again and confirm it.

STALE_STATE.title: The repository changed
STALE_STATE.hint: Something changed since it was read. It has been read again; check and try again.

HOOK_FAILED.title: A Git hook failed
HOOK_FAILED.hint: A hook in the repository refused the operation. Read its message below and fix what it reports.

UNKNOWN.title: Git failed
UNKNOWN.hint: Read Git's message below. If it does not explain the problem, try the same command in a terminal.

host.offline: {{host}} is offline. Actions are disabled until it reconnects.
host.outcomeUnknown: The connection was lost before {{host}} answered. The operation may or may not have finished; the repository is being read again.
host.offlineAction: {{host}} is offline: this action is unavailable.
host.busyOther: Wait for the running operation to finish.

safety.title: Safety
safety.info: These settings belong to this host. Advanced Git's daemon reads them before every destructive operation; they are all off by default.

allowForcePush.label: Allow force push
allowForcePush.hint: Push with --force-with-lease (never a bare --force) after a confirmation.
allowForcePush.warning: On: a force push can replace commits other people have pulled.

allowHardReset.label: Allow hard reset
allowHardReset.hint: Reset a branch with --hard after a confirmation.
allowHardReset.warning: On: a hard reset discards uncommitted changes in the work tree and the index.

allowForceDelete.label: Allow force delete
allowForceDelete.hint: Delete unmerged branches, remove worktrees with local changes, and clear all stashes.
allowForceDelete.warning: On: commits only reachable from a deleted branch, and dropped stashes, can be lost.

allowRemoteDelete.label: Allow deleting on remotes
allowRemoteDelete.hint: Delete branches and tags on a remote.
allowRemoteDelete.warning: On: deleting on a remote affects everyone who uses it.

protectedBranches.label: Protected branches
protectedBranches.hint: Branch patterns that are never force-pushed, deleted or hard-reset, whatever the switches above say. Separate them with commas; * matches within a segment, ** across segments.

safetySnapshots.label: Safety snapshots
safetySnapshots.hint: Before an operation that can discard tracked changes, record them under refs/advanced-git/snapshots so they can be restored.

view.title: View
view.info: These settings belong to this host: they apply to everyone using Advanced Git on it.

diffMode.label: Diff layout
diffMode.hint: Show diffs side by side or in one column.

diffWrap.label: Wrap long lines
diffWrap.hint: Wrap lines in diffs instead of scrolling sideways.

diffHideUnchanged.label: Collapse unchanged regions
diffHideUnchanged.hint: Fold long stretches of unchanged lines in diffs.

diffWhitespace.label: Whitespace
diffWhitespace.hint: Whether changes in leading and trailing whitespace count as changes.

syntaxHighlight.label: Syntax highlighting
syntaxHighlight.hint: Colour code in diffs by its language.

codeFontSize.label: Code font size
codeFontSize.hint: The size of code in diffs and blame.

graphScope.label: Graph shows
graphScope.hint: Which branches the commit graph shows by default.

autoFetch.label: Fetch automatically
autoFetch.hint: Fetch the selected repository in the background.

autoFetchMinutes.label: Fetch every
autoFetchMinutes.hint: How often the selected repository is fetched in the background.

confirmDiscard.label: Confirm before discarding
confirmDiscard.hint: Ask before discarding changes to files.

dateStyle.label: Dates
dateStyle.hint: Show commit dates as relative times or as dates.

gate.disabled: Turned off by “{{setting}}” in the safety settings.

shortcuts.intro: Shortcuts work while Advanced Git has focus.
